```{r Step 2: Initial Modeling on Trust by Race, include=TRUE}
run_trust_income <- function(data, race_group) {
  
  lapply(sort(unique(data$year)), function(y) {
    
    data_y <- data %>%
      filter(
        year == y,
        !is.na(trust_gov_index),
        !is.na(income_group_factor),
        !is.na(VCF0009z)
      )
    
    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    design_y <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )
    
    mod <- survey::svyglm(
      trust_gov_index ~ income_group_factor,
      design = design_y
    )
    
    list(
      year = y,
      race = race_group,
      n = nrow(data_y),
      model = mod
    )
  })
}

trust_black_income <- run_trust_income(
  black_anes,
  "Black"
)

trust_white_income <- run_trust_income(
  white_anes,
  "White"
)

trust_black_income
trust_white_income

run_trust_income_tests <- function(model_list) {
  
  purrr::map_dfr(model_list, function(x) {
    
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    
    test <- tryCatch(
      survey::regTermTest(
        x$model,
        ~ income_group_factor
      ),
      error = function(e) return(NULL)
    )
    
    if (is.null(test)) {
      return(tibble(
        year = x$year,
        race = x$race,
        n = x$n,
        F = NA_real_,
        df_num = NA_real_,
        df_den = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    
    tibble(
      year = x$year,
      race = x$race,
      n = x$n,
      F = unname(test$Ftest),
      df_num = unname(test$df),
      df_den = unname(test$ddf),
      p_value = unname(test$p)
    )
  })
}

trust_income_tests <- bind_rows(
  run_trust_income_tests(trust_black_income),
  run_trust_income_tests(trust_white_income)
)

trust_income_tests


run_trust_income_stock <- function(data, race_group) {
  
  lapply(sort(unique(data$year)), function(y) {
    
    data_y <- data %>%
      filter(
        year == y,
        !is.na(trust_gov_index),
        !is.na(income_group_factor),
        !is.na(stock_owns),
        !is.na(VCF0009z)
      )
    
    if (nrow(data_y) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    design_y <- survey::svydesign(
      ids = ~1,
      weights = ~VCF0009z,
      data = data_y
    )
    
    mod <- survey::svyglm(
      trust_gov_index ~ income_group_factor * stock_owns,
      design = design_y
    )
    
    list(
      year = y,
      race = race_group,
      n = nrow(data_y),
      model = mod
    )
  })
}

trust_black_income_stock <- run_trust_income_stock(
  black_anes,
  "Black"
)

trust_white_income_stock <- run_trust_income_stock(
  white_anes,
  "White"
)

run_trust_income_stock_tests <- function(model_list) {
  
  purrr::map_dfr(model_list, function(x) {
    
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    
    test <- tryCatch(
      survey::regTermTest(
        x$model,
        ~ income_group_factor:stock_owns
      ),
      error = function(e) return(NULL)
    )
    
    if (is.null(test)) {
      return(tibble(
        year = x$year,
        race = x$race,
        n = x$n,
        F = NA_real_,
        df_num = NA_real_,
        df_den = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    
    tibble(
      year = x$year,
      race = x$race,
      n = x$n,
      F = unname(test$Ftest),
      df_num = unname(test$df),
      df_den = unname(test$ddf),
      p_value = unname(test$p)
    )
  })
}

trust_income_stock_tests <- bind_rows(
  run_trust_income_stock_tests(trust_black_income_stock),
  run_trust_income_stock_tests(trust_white_income_stock)

trust_income_stock_tests

get_trust_predictions <- function(model_list) {
  
  results <- lapply(model_list, function(x) {
    
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    
    model_data <- model.frame(x$model)
    
    income_levels <- levels(model_data$income_group_factor)
    
    newdata <- expand.grid(
      income_group_factor = income_levels,
      stock_owns = c(0, 1)
    )
    
    newdata$income_group_factor <- factor(
      newdata$income_group_factor,
      levels = income_levels
    )
    
    newdata$predicted <- as.numeric(
      predict(
        x$model,
        newdata = newdata,
        type = "response"
      )
    )
    
    newdata$year <- x$year
    newdata$race <- x$race
    newdata$n <- x$n
    
    newdata
  })
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(results)
}

trust_black_predictions <- get_trust_predictions(
  trust_black_income_stock
)

trust_white_predictions <- get_trust_predictions(
  trust_white_income_stock
)

trust_black_predictions
trust_white_predictions
#Trust in government does not exhibit a stable income-by-stock-ownership relationship across the period examined. Income differences in trust vary considerably across election years, and the association between income and trust by stock ownership is statistically detectable only in selected waves. Among Black respondents, the income-by-stock interaction is significant in 2012 and marginal in 2020, while among White respondents it is significant in 2020. The predicted values indicate that these interactions are non-monotonic across the income distribution rather than reflecting a consistent gradient.
```
